name: Lovable
verdict: The fastest way to go from an idea to a deployed full-stack app; credits run out quickly on big projects.
cons: Business costs 2x for the same credits
pricingNote: Entry tiers on docs.lovable.dev/introduction/subscription-plans, checked 2026-10-14. The same table lists larger credit tiers up to 10,000 a month: Pro $2,250/mo ($1,875/mo annual) and Business $4,300/mo ($3,584/mo annual).
